events.text: Surveyed active editor paint UI: PaintToolbar owns two floating overlays (Brush and Ink/Color/Shader), both already write the shared model/facade Brush + color-spine state. Found the older unmounted ModelBrushDock/BrushKit implementation with isolated local drag state and the complete canonical brush vocabulary. Implementing paint-context left-rail pages that reuse that control core and relocate the live ink picker; no second painter or brush state.

Implemented the paint-context left dock. While model/facade paint is active, Section B now exposes Tool Options and Ink and Section C renders those persistent pages at the fixed 350px dock width; repeat-click still collapses it. Removed the Brush/Ink overlay state, scrim, and action-bar size/flow/shape/swatch clutter. Tool Options reuses the existing isolated BrushDials/BrushKit and now exposes shape, size, hardness, flow, scatter, angle, aspect, spacing, and blend; Ink preserves Color Library plus searched/paged live Shader selection and Color Studio handoff. Shared model/facade Brush and color-spine remain authoritative. Verification: panelSystem 8/8, tools/tsc-check editor green, SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor ReleaseFast green.

resolution: Paint mode now turns the formerly inert left gutter into a persistent, collapsible Tool Options / Ink dock driven by the center-stage context. The cramped size and flow strip plus both click-away paint overlays are gone; the dock reuses the shared drag-isolated BrushKit for every real brush field and preserves the Color Library, shader search/paging, and Color Studio handoff without creating a second painter or state path. Automated panel tests, editor bundle check, and the ReleaseFast editor ship all pass.
